title: Triangle angle sum: find the missing angle
subtitle: Lines, angles, and triangles · 16 official questions

sections.heading: Where this sits for you
body: **16 of the official questions in Lines, angles, and triangles are this one** — 11 Easy, 3 Medium, 2 Hard.
It is bottom-heavy, which makes it cheap points. Secure it early.

sections.heading: How to spot it
body: You are looking at this pattern when:
- The question involves a single triangle, drawn or described in words.
- Two angles are given (or their sum), or all three are given as expressions in one variable, and you're asked for the third angle or the variable.
- An isosceles condition such as two equal sides may be the hidden extra fact.
